paragraphs.text: Cleon , also known as the Merry Champion , is a human soldier from an unknown plane.
Let us dance ‘round the funeral pyres of our foes!

Cleon is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Red Stoked deck . They wield a flail spear and wear metal armor with a golden helm that has two horns sticking out of its sides. Based on their appearance, they are potentially a soldier from Theros who are known for their cheerful appearance in battle.
